title: Update existing listings instead of upserting
context: Three listing mutation paths used upsert, omitting owner_id required by the INSERT policy.
options: Use UPDATE filtered by listing id.
choice: Use UPDATE for edits, hiding and restoring existing listings.
tradeoff: No lost creation capability on this path, according to owner confirmation recorded in docs/seed-promotion-drafts.md: it only changes an existing listing.

evidence.label: Recorded owner cost confirmation; options still need review

title: Replace unknown UPDATE policies with one owner policy
context: Original listing policies were manually created and their names were not versioned. The migration records rejected owner updates.
options: Discover and replace all listing UPDATE policies.
choice: Iterate pg_policies, drop listing UPDATE policies and create one owner-only policy.
tradeoff: The script also removes any other listing UPDATE rule and contains no rollback. This inferred cost needs owner confirmation.

title: Deliver notification events through database triggers
context: The migration records that the dashboard Database Webhooks UI was unavailable on this project.
options: Use the unavailable dashboard Webhooks UI.
Use triggers and pg_net with Vault lookups.
choice: Triggers post booking and message events to the Edge Function.
tradeoff: Two Vault reads per invocation; missing configuration skips delivery while the insert succeeds. The owner confirmed these costs in docs/seed-promotion-drafts.md. Production delivery is unverified.

evidence.label: Owner-confirmed costs; options still need review
